algorithms.intercept: nearest <=5m, relative constant-velocity closest approach <=1.5m within0.4s; continuous actor and ball
algorithms.changepoint: nearest<=3m and smoothed backward ball acceleration>15m/s2 or direction change>60deg at speed>2; suppress >45m/s and invalid samples

limitations: 2D ball only; no verified height, airborne/rolling regimes are not identifiable. Quantization can induce apparent acceleration. Association with BAS is not independent physical truth.
